The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/11/2023 at 23:02:13 application on the ground that the allegations against the applicant/appellant are serious in nature and that there is no merit in the application.
Learned APP further pressed that as per Nominal Roll dated 02.11.2023, the overall conduct of the applicant/appellant is unsatisfactory and has been awarded punishment thrice.
6. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant/appellant submits that some other inmates were involved in the offence and the whole cell was punished for the same.
Therefore, it is not established that the mobile phone, knife and heater was recovered from the applicant/appellant.

However, the Office of the Superintendent, Central Jail No. 8/9, Tihar, New Delhi vide letter dated 15.08.2023 issued a Letter of Appreciation in favour of the applicant/appellant by submitting that his conduct is good, he is hardworking and is working at the Control Room, at Central Jail mentioned above.

entities.text: Office of the Superintendent, Central Jail No. 8/9, Tihar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Sincere and dedicated efforts were made by him in assisting the jail administration towards enforcement of law and order and overall smooth functioning of the jail.
7. As per nominal roll dated 02.11.2023, the applicant / appellant has already undergone 06 years 07 months and 07 days and earned remission of 03 months and 01 day as on 02.11.2023.
Thus, as on date, he has completed almost 07 years of incarceration.
The present appeal is of 2023 and this Court is hearing the old appeals, thus the present appeal shall take substantial time to be heard.

8. Keeping in view the incarceration period already undergone and the appreciation of letter issued by the Jail Authorities, we hereby suspend the sentence of applicant / appellant during the pendency of the appeal and he shall be released on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 10,000/-
